scripts.build: npm run coverage && npm run lint && echo 'Build complete!' && node tools/coverageSummary.js --print-last-summary
scripts.lint: node tools/lint/mapSvgIntegrity.js && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:js: node tools/lint/jsFilenameStyle.js && node tools/lint/jsImportStyle.js && eslint scripts && echo 'All checks passed!'
scripts.lint:py: python3 tools/lint/pythonImportStyle.py && python3 tools/lint/pythonHouseStyle.py && python3 tools/lint/jsonSeedStyle.py && ruff check .
